about: First-round pick obligations applied by resolvePickOwnership() after every lottery simulation or standings refresh. Team codes match data.js (NYK, NOP, SAS, UTA, GSW, WAS). Rules run in listed order; each rule addresses picks by their ORIGINAL team. 'verified: false' marks terms that should be confirmed against an official source before relying on them.

ruleTypes.unprotected: Pick conveys to recipientTeam wherever it lands.
ruleTypes.protected: If the pick lands inside protectedRange, originalTeam keeps it; otherwise it conveys to recipientTeam.
ruleTypes.split_conveyance: Pick goes to the route whose range contains the slot.
ruleTypes.swap_pool: Pool picks are sorted by slot; 'assign' hands out most_favorable / least_favorable / numeric ranks. 'overrides' replace 'assign' when their condition holds. 'exclude' drops a protected pick from the pool. Unassigned pool picks stay with their current owner.

rules.description: Dallas owes Charlotte its 2027 first, top-2 protected.
Miami owes Charlotte its 2027 first, lottery (top-14) protected.
The Lakers owe Memphis their 2027 first, top-4 protected.
New York's 2027 first goes to Brooklyn, unprotected (Mikal Bridges trade).
Atlanta's 2027 first goes to San Antonio, unprotected (Dejounte Murray trade).
San Antonio's 2027 first goes to Sacramento if it lands 1–16, otherwise to Oklahoma City.
Houston may swap 2027 firsts with Brooklyn and takes the more favorable pick (James Harden trade).

overrides.description: Both picks landed in the top 4, so New Orleans keeps both.

rules.description: New Orleans gets the more favorable of the NOP and MIL firsts; Atlanta gets the less favorable, unless both land in the top 4, in which case New Orleans keeps both.
Memphis receives the most favorable of the Cleveland, Utah and Minnesota firsts; the other two stay with their teams.

exclude.description: Denver's pick is top-5 protected from this swap.

rules.description: Oklahoma City holds swap rights over the LAC, DEN (top-5 protected) and TOR firsts and takes the most favorable pick in the group. Terms simplified: confirm how the remaining picks are distributed.
New York's 2029 first goes to Brooklyn, unprotected (Mikal Bridges trade).
The Lakers' 2029 first goes to Dallas (Luka Dončić trade).
